justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/aztec/encoder/SimpleToken.java, plus Token.java and BinaryShiftToken.java for context. SimpleToken is a very small final helper class: 1 constructor, 2 overridden methods, 2 fields, and about 25 lines of code. Its behavior is tightly focused on storing a token value/bit count and appending those bits, so there is no evidence of excessive size, multiple responsibilities, or low cohesion that would indicate insufficient modularization.
